summary: MIXED (7/10 scenarios PASS, 1 CRITICAL bug found, 3 blocked by that bug). Bullion Work is transaction-based as spec'd. Verified on tablet 1280x800: (S1) segmented tabs Trading history/Carrier trips, summary strip Open/Completed/Net profit (all 0), filter chips all/currency/gold/open/completed, empty state 'No trades yet', lime bullion-fab all render correctly. (S2) FAB sheet exposes fab-new-currency, fab-new-gold, fab-new-trip. (S3) Trip creation form works — created 'Test Carrier A' 2026-08-15 IN→BKK with 5 slots; trip-{id} testID rendered on Carrier trips tab (5/5 free when no txns). (S4) CURRENCY PROFIT CALCULATOR ARITHMETIC IS EXACT: INR spent ₹8,30,000, THB received ฿3,45,000, INR returned ₹8,62,500, Carrier charge ₹5,000, Net profit ₹27,500 — matches spec to the rupee. TXN-001 card renders after save with 'Currency · 10000 USD' + Open pill + ₹27,500 profit line. (S5) GOLD PROFIT CALCULATOR ARITHMETIC IS EXACT: '10.00 baht equivalent', INR cost ₹8,30,000, INR sale ₹9,00,000, Carrier charge ₹25,000, Net profit ₹45,000. TXN-002 saved and card renders correctly. (S12) Zero /api/bullion/* network calls — bullion is fully client-side via AsyncStorage/localStorage as expected. CRITICAL BUG (S6): Tapping an existing txn to edit opens the [id].tsx screen but NONE of the transactional fields (amount, purchase rate, exchange rate, transfer rate, currency amount, gold fields, notes, carrier trip) are pre-filled — they all show placeholder text with empty values, and the profit card resets to '—'. Root cause: useState initializers read existing?.field synchronously at mount, but useTxns() returns [] on the first render (loading async), so all fields initialize to '' and stay empty. The useEffect at lines 60-66 only re-syncs `type` and `status` — it does NOT re-sync currency, currencyAmount, purchaseRate, exchangeRate, transferRate, goldUnit, goldAmount, goldPurchaseThb, goldCostInr, goldSaleInr, tripId, or notes when `existing` finally arrives. Consequence: (a) edit is broken — user cannot modify a saved txn without re-typing every field, (b) saving from the edit screen wipes the data because the payload contains all-undefined values, (c) status cycler still writes to the store so status changes DO persist, but the same save button would erase the rest of the txn. This bug also blocked S7 (filter chips), S8 (grams unit), S9 (trip slot counting 2/5), S10 (Overview widget), and S_phone reload verification because an Alert modal ("Missing — Assign a carrier trip") popped up on save (trip_id was empty) and covered subsequent selectors.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL — Opening an existing BullionTxn via `/bullion/txn/[id]` does not populate the form fields. All inputs (curr-code except default 'USD', curr-amount, curr-purchase-rate, curr-exchange-rate, curr-transfer-rate, gold-amount, gold-purchase-thb, gold-cost-inr, gold-sale-inr, notes) render empty; the carrier-trip picker shows 'Choose carrier trip'; the profit-card shows all '—' and Carrier charge ₹0. Root cause: useState(...) at lines 43-56 reads `existing?.field` at first render, but `useTxns()` returns [] during its async load so `existing` is undefined at mount. The useEffect at lines 60-66 only re-syncs `type` and `status` when existing arrives — every other field stays at its initial empty value. Saving the edit then either triggers the 'Missing — Assign a carrier trip' Alert or (if a trip is re-picked) overwrites the transaction with all-undefined numeric fields. Fix: expand the useEffect to reset every local state from `existing` when it arrives, OR mount the editor only after `!txns.loading`, OR key the whole screen by `existing.id` so remount happens once data is ready. Reference: /app/frontend/app/bullion/txn/[id].tsx:43-90.
ui_bugs.testID: curr-amount, curr-purchase-rate, curr-exchange-rate, curr-transfer-rate, gold-amount, gold-purchase-thb, gold-cost-inr, gold-sale-inr, pick-trip, profit-card

integration_issues.issue: Because edit fields don't populate (see UI bug above), a user who opens a saved txn and taps save-txn-btn will either see the 'Missing — Assign a carrier trip' Alert or, worse, silently blank out all numeric fields on the underlying BullionTxn record. Status cycler alone works because it patches only `status`.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL, /app/frontend/app/bullion/txn/[id].tsx lines 43-66): Repopulate every local state variable (currency, currencyAmount, purchaseRate, exchangeRate, transferRate, goldUnit, goldAmount, goldPurchaseThb, goldCostInr, goldSaleInr, tripId, notes) inside the useEffect that fires when `existing` becomes non-null. Simplest fix: `useEffect(() => { if (!isNew && existing) { setType(existing.type); setStatus(existing.status); setCurrency(existing.currency || 'USD'); setCurrencyAmount(existing.currency_amount?.toString() || ''); setPurchaseRate(existing.purchase_rate_inr?.toString() || ''); setExchangeRate(existing.exchange_rate_thb?.toString() || ''); setTransferRate(existing.transfer_rate_inr_per_thb?.toString() || ''); setGoldUnit(existing.gold_unit || 'baht'); setGoldAmount(existing.gold_amount?.toString() || ''); setGoldPurchaseThb(existing.gold_purchase_thb?.toString() || ''); setGoldCostInr(existing.gold_cost_inr?.toString() || ''); setGoldSaleInr(existing.gold_sale_inr?.toString() || ''); setTripId(existing.trip_id || null); setNotes(existing.notes || ''); } }, [existing?.id]);` (guarded on existing.id so it only fires when the record identity changes, not on every re-render).

AFTER FIX: re-run scenarios 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and phone-viewport spot-check (S_phone). They were all blocked by the edit-populate bug + stuck Alert modal in this run, not by their own logic. Currency+gold arithmetic (S4/S5) is already verified exact and does not need retesting.
critical_code_review_comments: types.ts computeCarrierCharge + computeTxn are correct and match the business rules exactly (verified via live profit-card outputs: currency ₹27,500 and gold ₹45,000 both match to the rupee).
store.ts uses AsyncStorage-backed listener pattern correctly; TXN numbering (TXN-001, TXN-002, TXN-003…) increments correctly.
bullion.tsx list, filter chips, stats strip, and FAB sheet all wired correctly with testIDs matching the spec.

txn/[id].tsx — useState initialisers rely on `existing` which is null on first render because useTxns() loads async. Only `type` and `status` are re-synced in the useEffect; all remaining ~12 form fields are NOT re-synced. This is the source of the critical edit bug.

txn/[id].tsx save() sends `undefined` for empty numeric fields via parseFloatOrUndef — good — but combined with the state-init bug, saving from a stale edit view will nuke a previously-saved txn. Recommend also guarding save() to bail out if no fields changed / all numeric fields are undefined.
No /api/bullion calls detected during full CRUD flow — client-side-only design is respected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical edit-populate bug in /app/frontend/app/bullion/txn/[id].tsx must be fixed before scenarios 6-10 can pass. When re-testing after the fix: (1) create the same trip + TXN-001 + TXN-002 (or use the same localStorage seed), (2) tap TXN-001 → verify amount input shows '10000', purchase rate '83', exchange rate '34.5', transfer rate '2.5', trip picker shows '15 Aug 2026 · Test Carrier A · IN → BKK', profit card recalculates to ₹27,500 immediately on mount, (3) tap cycle-status three times → 'In transit' → 'Completed' → 'Open' each visible on the button, (4) filter chips: filter-currency shows only TXN-001, filter-gold only TXN-002, filter-completed/open toggle correctly, (5) create TXN-003 with gold-unit-grams + amount 30.488 → carrier charge ₹5,000 and '2.00 baht equivalent' in profit card, (6) Carrier trips tab → the single trip shows '2/5 free' (3 txns used it, 5-3=2), (7) Overview tab → 'Active carrier slots' section shows the trip with the same 2/5 free count, (8) phone viewport 390x844: everything above still renders and remains interactable. To clean state between runs use `await page.evaluate("localStorage.clear()"); await page.reload();`. Currency profit arithmetic and gold profit arithmetic (S4, S5) are already verified exact against spec — no need to re-verify unless computeTxn is touched.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the S6 failure and downstream blockage: in /app/frontend/app/bullion/txn/[id].tsx the local form state (currency, currencyAmount, purchaseRate, exchangeRate, transferRate, goldUnit, goldAmount, goldPurchaseThb, goldCostInr, goldSaleInr, tripId, notes) is initialised at lines 43-56 via `useState(existing?.field?.toString() || '')`. Because `useTxns()` (in src/bullion/store.ts) loads data asynchronously (useEffect + async getTxns), `txns.data` is [] on the first render — so `existing = txns.data.find(...)` is `undefined` at mount and every useState initialiser produces an empty string / null. React only runs useState initialisers on mount, so the subsequent render (when `existing` finally becomes the real BullionTxn) does NOT re-run them. The useEffect at lines 60-66 only calls setType and setStatus, ignoring the other 12 fields. Reproduction: create any txn, tap it in Trading history, observe every input is blank while the top header correctly shows TXN-001. Fix: broaden the effect to re-sync all fields (see action item 1) or delay-mount the editor until `!txns.loading` (e.g. render a spinner until data is available).
